usage: The word '叉燒' refers to a specific type of roasted pork dish popular in Cantonese cuisine.
'叉燒' is used as a noun and can appear as the subject or object in a sentence.
When ordering food, you can say '我想要一份叉燒' (I want a serving of BBQ pork).
It can be combined with other dishes, like '叉燒飯' (char siu rice).
You can also ask questions like '有冇叉燒？' (Do you have BBQ pork?).
